description: Maintain a continuously-reconciled SBOM corpus across every scenario's lockfiles, annotated with known-vuln status, in Qdrant — the justifying feature beyond being a test-genie producer.

requirements.title: Dependency discovery across the fleet
requirements.description: Discovery must walk every scenario's go.mod and pnpm-lock.yaml and produce a DependencyRecord{scenario, ecosystem(go|npm), name, version, source_file, vuln_ids[], max_severity, last_seen} per dependency.

validation.notes: Parsing a go.mod yields one DependencyRecord per required module with ecosystem=go.
Parsing a pnpm-lock.yaml yields DependencyRecords with ecosystem=npm.

requirements.title: Reconcile loop + vuln annotation
requirements.description: A 5-minute reconcile loop must upsert/delete dependency records in the Qdrant collection (security-health-deps, dimensions resolved from `embedding.default`, cosine) based on a payload hash, and annotate vuln_ids/max_severity from the Phase C scanners (osv-scanner/govulncheck/pnpm audit).

validation.notes: A changed dependency version produces a planned upsert; an unchanged one produces no write.
A dependency with a known CVE gets vuln_ids populated and max_severity set.
